note: Forward topics the news classifier (prompt v1.7) can tag, and the Kalshi market behind each. 'risk_side' says which side of the market is the article's 'yes'. max_gap_days = how far the market's resolution date may be from the article's effect date.

fed_cut.question: Will the Fed cut rates at its next meeting?
fed_cut.status: confirmed series; 'yes' = sum of all cut outcomes

government_shutdown.question: Will there be a government shutdown?

debt_limit_breach.question: Will the debt limit be missed (X-date reached without a raise)?
debt_limit_breach.status: ticker to find (collect.py discover --search debt ceiling); markets are usually phrased 'raised before X-date', so 'yes' here = the market's NO side

recession.question: Will the US enter a recession this year?
